findings.reason: a node dispatched on f-cfs-moment-path-reconcile would close at 2,000 cells and the 5,000/10,000-carrier requalification the decision mandates would never be scheduled, silently leaving §2/§4/§6 acceptance rows at those rungs unrequalified.
findings.text: the decision's rat says "The certified carriers are regenerated and requalified at 550, 2,000, 5,000 and 10,000 cells ... Followup f-cfs-moment-path-reconcile carries the repair", but that followup's done-when is bounded at "550 and 2,000 cells", and its title/goal is host-vs-device path reconciliation rather than carrier requalification; f-cfs-near-edge-moment separately presupposes the "5,000 and 10,000-cell carriers are regenerated" without naming an owner — so the two finest requalification rungs the decision requires are orphaned across the plan

findings.reason: the claim (chord is the production default) is true and the cited files resolve, so the node still finds the default; only the line pointers are wrong, which a reader repairs by grepping for "chord" and does not change what the followup asks for.
findings.text: the followup cites "the public production request ... both default to chord support (solve_request.py:309, forward_operator.py:2341)", but solve_request.py:309 resolves to the ForwardSolvePolicy `route` field and the chord default is declared at solve_request.py:579 (`clip_mode: SupportClipMode = "chord"`) and :640, while forward_operator.py:2341 is the `wall_unit_offsets` field (the chord default is at :2343)

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — f-cfs-chord-default-arm cites solve_request.py:309 for "the public production request ... default to chord support", but line 309 is the ForwardSolvePolicy route field; the chord default is declared at solve_request.py:579 and :640.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §2, §3 and §4 each declare a negative control ("a negative control fails the position/private-flux/one-program clause") and the new f-cfs-newton-production-seed carries its own ("with the residual-only control failing the map clause"); the changed followups are dispatch recommendations, not gate-bearing nodes.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the new units cite durable evidence fragments under docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/ and the cfs-moment-path-reconcile run logs, not a scratchpad or node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new decision and followups carry no plan/phase/ticket identifiers in symbols or prose, and name mechanisms (packed moment kernel, reflected edge pairing, warm wall) rather than tracker entries.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the decision's stated root cause (the packed polygon moment kernel in nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py, shared by both builders) matches the cfs-moment-path-reconcile evidence it cites and the independent reference the review recorded; the 550/2,000 path agreement and map pair it leans on are the figures those runs measured.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each of the six new followups states one deliverable (route the support, repair the warm wall, reconcile the two coupling paths, fix the production-seed Newton defect, measure the chord default, repair the near-edge moment accuracy).
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the new moment-kernel-repair decision assigns carrier regeneration and requalification at 5,000 and 10,000 cells to f-cfs-moment-path-reconcile, whose own done-when stops at 550 and 2,000 cells, so no node in the plan carries the two finest rungs of the declared requalification.
